name: Sprint Board
description: Scrum-style board for time-boxed development sprints.

columns.name: todo
columns.label: To Do
columns.description: Tasks accepted into this sprint but not yet started.
columns.hint: Move here when a task is committed to the sprint scope and ready to be picked up.

columns.name: in_progress
columns.label: In Progress
columns.hint: Move here when you begin work on the task.

columns.name: in_review
columns.label: In Review
columns.description: Implementation complete, awaiting code review or QA.
columns.hint: Move here when your implementation is done and needs human review or testing.

columns.name: done
columns.label: Done
columns.hint: Move here after review passes and the work is merged or deployed.
